section.name: Usign STextField
section.p:
In the Model:
Provide a public getter method for the String to be mapped to the STextField:

In the Controller:
If you set a ControlID for the STextField, provide an else if clause for that Control in the Controller's doHandleControl() method.

Built in validation:
In the focusLost event, the STextField automatically validates against the datatype of the getter method to which the field is mapped. If the entered value is inconsistent with the datatype, the STextField background will turn pink to indicate the error.
